effects.name: Healing Wave
effects.description: A restorative chain jumps between up to four allies, losing 15% healing per jump.

effects.name: War Stomp
effects.description: Stomp the ground, damaging and stunning enemies within five metres of the caster.

effects.name: Frost Nova
effects.description: Strike the primary target with frost, then damage and slow surrounding enemies without repeating the primary hit.

effects.name: Golden Mend Burst
effects.description: A warm amber-gold healing flash with a soft ground halo and rising sparks.

effects.name: Fireball Projectile
effects.description: A bright amber core surrounded by orange fire, travelling along the authoritative projectile link.

effects.name: Fireball Impact
effects.description: An orange impact flash with a short expanding ground ring and scattered cooling embers.

effects.name: Fireball Preparation
effects.description: A brief warm glow gathers around the caster before release.

effects.name: Searing Arrow Flight
effects.description: A soft orange flame and small golden core locked to the released weapon flight.

effects.name: Black Arrow · Flight
effects.description: Reusable violet shadow layers for the Black Arrow proof.

effects.name: Black Arrow · Manifestation
effects.description: Reusable violet shadow layers for the Black Arrow proof.

effects.name: Verdant Ward — Leaf Burst
effects.description: Warm green leaves unfurl at the recipient on release, with a restrained golden-green healing glow.

effects.name: Verdant Ward — Living Shield
effects.description: Subtle target-following green ward, sustained only while the absorption status is active.

effects.name: Frost Relay — Icy Link
effects.description: Bright cyan link with a pale frozen core, rendered between authoritative chain endpoints.

effects.name: Frost Relay — Crystal Impact
effects.description: Readable blue shock ring and ice splinters using the published Blizzard ice texture.

effects.name: Ember Garden — Ground and Sparks
effects.description: Six-second amber ground bed with a readable boundary and drifting upward embers.

effects.name: Ember Garden — Fire Blooms
effects.description: Short small amber fire bursts scattered across the garden at each damage pulse.

effects.name: Amber Mend — Golden Link
effects.description: Graceful amber ribbon and fine luminous core between runtime chain endpoints.

effects.name: Amber Mend — Impact Petals
effects.description: Small bright warm-spark petals open around the healed ally, with a restrained amber halo.

effects.name: Moonpetal Ward — Lunar Veil
effects.description: Cool sustained glow, original rotating moon-petal ground glyph, and an independent two-second breathing glyph. Bound to the shield status.

effects.name: Cinder Pin — Projectile
effects.description: A narrow orange pin with a warm gold core, following the authoritative projectile link.

effects.name: Cinder Pin — Impact
effects.description: A compact orange burst and six warm sparks at the struck enemy; cosmetic only.

effects.name: Dewspring — Healing Ripple
effects.description: A subtle turquoise ripple marking each healing pulse at the spring point.

effects.name: Cinder Pin — Root Embers
effects.description: A thin breathing ember ring, low translucent warmth and sparse rising sparks surround the rooted unit without obscuring its body. Sustained only for the root status.

effects.name: Blizzard — Frost Impact Sound
effects.description: One Frost Impact one-shot at each Blizzard damage wave. Sound only; bound to wave, not waveStarted.

effects.name: Bloodlust Hand Flares
effects.description: Localized warm red-gold flares and sparse embers following warrior hand sockets, offset clear of equipment. Hides on incompatible actors; bound to status lifetime.

effects.name: Dewspring — Spring
effects.description: A soft turquoise five-second ground pool with a restrained boundary and sparse rising droplets. Emission ends early enough for its 44-tick particle tails to finish at spring expiry.

effects.name: Spore Sanctuary · Mushroom Patch
effects.description: Cosmetic woodland mushroom mesh with gently drifting green-gold spores and subdued ground light. Emission ends early so all tails clear at five seconds.

effects.name: Inferno
effects.description: Bounded golden-orange ignition, curved fire tongues and fading embers. Original 4×4 impact atlas; presentation only.

effects.name: Spirit Swarm · Seeker
effects.description: Small green-gold seekers with short, narrow fading ribbons following their observed delivery paths.

effects.name: Rallying Spark — Gold-Green Link
effects.description: Crisp two-tone restorative chain link; runtime supplies each jump endpoint.

effects.name: Rallying Spark — Leafy Burst
effects.description: Brief readable leaf unfurl with a restrained golden pulse at each healed recipient.

effects.name: Rallying Spark — Quiet Ward
effects.description: Restrained attached green-gold ward, owned by the armor status.

effects.name: Ashstep — departure flash
effects.description: Reusable fixed-position orange and teal teleport flash; no gameplay.

effects.name: Ashstep — arrival burst
effects.description: Reusable teal shock ring, orange core and short-lived sparks at a captured landing.

effects.name: Sleep
effects.description: Gentle floating lavender crescent and cyclic dream motes, owned by the affected Sleep status.

effects.name: Frost Relay — Lingering Chill
effects.description: Low frost ring and drifting ice motes, cleaned up with the three-second chill status.

effects.name: Black Arrow · Mark
effects.description: Reusable violet shadow layers for the Black Arrow proof.
